about: Terms the Vietnamese UI keeps in English. scripts/check-i18n-messages.mjs reports every vi message that uses a banned translation. Matching ignores case and only hits whole words. 'ignore' lists longer phrases that contain a banned word but mean something else (phiên bản = version); they never count. 'allow' exempts one phrase in one message on purpose: { key: '<namespace>.<dotted.key>', phrase, reason }, where phrase is the banned word itself or a longer phrase around it. Only list a banned word here when it is clearly a translation of the term: generic words such as 'lệnh', 'công cụ', 'vấn đề', 'điều hướng' or 'trích' are left out on purpose.

terms.note: 'lệnh' alone is generic (shell command, command palette), so only 'lệnh slash' is banned.
'vấn đề' is too generic to ban.
